reason: The posted daily cleaning log, shoes off, the 25-kid cap and the gated Baby Nook for my 10-month-old are what I'd look for first. The free first visit lets me check it myself before spending anything, and my 4-year-old would like the pretend market.
objection: A cleaning log is only paper. I want to see toys actually wiped down and a sick kid turned away, because my baby chews everything. It also isn't open until next year, so I can't judge it yet.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing it clean in person on the free visit, with toys being wiped between kids and a clear sick-kid policy. If it looked grubby, I'd never return.
